_design: First visit to the farm: he names the robot, picks its colour, and names the farm. The names are shown on screen; narration never says them, so every line can be pre-recorded.

lines.askRobotName: Hello! I'm a little robot, and I live on this farm. I don't have a name yet. What do you want to call me? Tap the microphone and say it, or type it.
lines.likeName: I love it! That's my name now.
lines.askColour: What colour should I be? Tap one.
lines.askFarmName: And what shall we call this farm?
lines.farmNamed: What a good name for a farm. Now, I need your help…
lines.tryAgain: Say it again, or type it.
